meaning: A device that answers a phone call and records a caller's message when you cannot pick up.
clues: It takes a phone message when you are away or cannot answer.
A recorded greeting asks the caller to leave a message.
You press play to hear the saved messages, and you can erase them.
Old models used wire or tape to record sound.
It has two words. The first has nine letters and starts with A.

decoys.meaning: A machine that records and plays back sound on magnetic tape.
A machine that records sound on a long magnetic tape wound between two open reels.
One phone line shared by several homes, so neighbors could pick up and hear each other's calls.

exchange.speaker: floyd
exchange.text: A caller could leave the details, and you could hear them later. A saved message still helps you remember what matters.

exchange.speaker: bud
exchange.text: Today's version: a phone service can take a message when you do not answer, then show you the recording.

exchange.speaker: floyd
exchange.text: The little machine gave you breathing room. You did not have to reach the phone every time it rang.
